# SwMacroFlow

> A free standalone Windows application that runs chains of SOLIDWORKS VBA macros across hundreds of
> parts, assemblies and drawings unattended. It opens each file once, runs every macro selected
> against it in order, closes it, and records what each macro reported.

SwMacroFlow drives an installed, licensed x64 SOLIDWORKS session from outside. Nothing is registered
or installed inside SOLIDWORKS itself, and it needs no administrator rights. It is free with every
feature included: macro chaining, batch runs across folders, parallel batches across two to four
SOLIDWORKS instances, a bundled macro library, an AI Copilot side panel (bring your own API key,
with image, PDF, Word and text attachments), and Windows Task Scheduler integration. There is no
trial, no licence, no account, and nothing to buy.

## Product

- [Home](https://swmacroflow.in/): what SwMacroFlow does, how a batch runs, and the download.
- [Documentation](https://swmacroflow.in/docs.html): every guide, from a first batch to the macro authoring contract.
- [Macro library](https://swmacroflow.in/macros.html): free SOLIDWORKS .swp macros to download.

## Guides

- [SwMacroFlow](https://swmacroflow.in/docs/overview/): SwMacroFlow runs one or more SOLIDWORKS macros across many parts, assemblies and drawings without anyone sitting in front of the screen. It opens each file once, runs every macro you ticked against...
- [Using the app](https://swmacroflow.in/docs/using-the-app/): A walk through the window, panel by panel, in the order they appear on screen.
- [Writing a macro](https://swmacroflow.in/docs/writing-a-macro/): Any SOLIDWORKS VBA macro with an argument-less Sub main works. There is no SwMacroFlow-specific code to add, no library to reference, and no result object to fill in. A macro written for SwMacroFlow...
- [Adding inputs](https://swmacroflow.in/docs/adding-inputs/): An input is a value the user fills in before the run. You declare it in the macro; SwMacroFlow builds the control, validates what is typed, and substitutes the value into your code before it runs.
- [Reporting a result](https://swmacroflow.in/docs/reporting-results/): Use MsgBox. During a batch no dialog opens - SwMacroFlow defines its own MsgBox inside the throwaway copy it runs, so each call becomes that file's row in the results list instead.
- [Macro authoring spec](https://swmacroflow.in/docs/macro-authoring-spec/): The complete contract for a macro that runs under SwMacroFlow, stated in one place.
- [Troubleshooting](https://swmacroflow.in/docs/troubleshooting/): Symptom first. Each heading is what you actually see.

## Macros

- [Change Document Unit](https://swmacroflow.in/macros/change-document-unit/): Sets the document's unit system and the individual length, angle, mass, volume, time, force, power and energy units. Optionally switches inch dimensions to fractions.
- [Change Drawing Template](https://swmacroflow.in/macros/change-drawing-template/): Applies a .slddrt sheet format to one sheet, several named sheets, or every sheet in a drawing, then rebuilds and saves.
- [Export Properties to CSV](https://swmacroflow.in/macros/export-properties-to-csv/): Appends every custom property of each document to one CSV. A folder of 300 files produces one spreadsheet, not 300. Works on parts, assemblies and drawings.
- [Find and Replace in Properties](https://swmacroflow.in/macros/find-and-replace-in-properties/): Replaces text inside custom property values across many files. Works on parts, assemblies and drawings.
- [Import Properties from CSV](https://swmacroflow.in/macros/import-properties-from-csv/): Writes custom properties into documents from a spreadsheet. Reads the long-format CSV that Export Properties to CSV writes, picks the rows belonging to each document, and writes them.
- [Insert Block In Drawings](https://swmacroflow.in/macros/insert-block-in-drawings/): Inserts a .sldblk sketch block at a fixed position on one sheet, several named sheets, or every sheet in a drawing, then rebuilds and saves.
- [Rename Custom Property](https://swmacroflow.in/macros/rename-custom-property/): Renames a custom property across many files. Works on parts, assemblies and drawings.
- [Save Drawing as DXF or DWG](https://swmacroflow.in/macros/save-drawing-as-dxf-or-dwg/): Exports the open drawing to DXF or DWG. Parts and assemblies are reported as unsupported — use Save Neutral Format for those.
- [Save eDrawings](https://swmacroflow.in/macros/save-edrawings/): Exports the open document as an eDrawings file, for sending to people who do not have SOLIDWORKS.
- [Save Neutral Format](https://swmacroflow.in/macros/save-neutral-format/): Exports the open part or assembly to Parasolid, IGES, STL, ACIS or 3D XML. Drawings are reported as unsupported.
- [Save PDF](https://swmacroflow.in/macros/save-pdf/): Exports the open document to PDF. Works on parts, assemblies and drawings.
- [Save Preview Image](https://swmacroflow.in/macros/save-preview-image/): Captures a bitmap of the open document. Works on parts, assemblies and drawings — on a drawing it captures the active sheet.
- [Save STEP](https://swmacroflow.in/macros/save-step/): Exports the open part or assembly to a STEP file. Drawings are reported as unsupported.
- [Save with Performance Improvement](https://swmacroflow.in/macros/save-with-performance-improvement/): Turns image quality down to its cheapest settings — shaded deviation at maximum, high-quality edges off, wireframe quality at its lowest — then saves a copy named <name>_Optimized.
- [Set Custom Property](https://swmacroflow.in/macros/set-custom-property/): Writes one custom property across every file in the scope. Works on parts, assemblies and drawings.
- [Write Mass Properties](https://swmacroflow.in/macros/write-mass-properties/): Measures the model and writes mass, volume, surface area and centre of mass into custom properties, so a BOM or a drawing note can read them. Parts and assemblies only — drawings have no geometry to...
